intents.why: A release note is documentation. Load the docs skill in the same turn.
A review that finds a gap should be able to ask for a test in the same turn.
Read-only queries stay on the query skill.

skills.name: draft-docs
skills.description: Rewrite a project README or setup documentation for new contributors.
skills.oneLine: Rewrite a project README or setup documentation for new contributors.

skills.name: explain-code
skills.description: Explain a module or flow for a new hire. Use when someone says explain, walk me through, or how does this work.
skills.oneLine: Explain a module or flow for a new hire. Use when someone says explain, walk me through, or how does this work.

skills.name: http-api-guide
skills.description: Curated reference for HTTP and REST API design, including status codes, pagination, and idempotency.
skills.oneLine: Curated reference for HTTP and REST API design, including status codes, pagination, and idempotency.

skills.name: query-data
skills.description: Author and run a read-only database query. Use for SQL, SOQL, or a SELECT against orders or accounts.
skills.oneLine: Author and run a read-only database query. Use for SQL, SOQL, or a SELECT against orders or accounts.

skills.name: review-pull-request
